name: Ashley
source:
[quote]If bringing you back is what it takes, then I'll do anything at all... that, and nothing more.[/quote]

A girl the Empire wants caught, living her life in its shadows. She moves alone by choice, and there is no one better at the quiet work done out of sight. Cool, dry, every word coming out flat and lifeless, and perhaps that is exactly why no one can ever read what lies behind her eyes.

Like Loretta, she means to throw in with Lucius and see the Empire fall... or so it would appear.

She is the bearer of the rune of "Control": let a living body cross into her sight, and she can strengthen it, or bend it entirely to her will.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/chara03.html]official website[/url]]
